findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/KnotTheory/Grid/Diagram.lean:317` has `theorem mem_columnSwapNeighbors ... ↔ ∃ c d : Fin n, c ≠ d ∧ y = x.swapColumns c d`; the new lemma at line 50 is exactly its forward constructor case.
findings.fix: Remove this public wrapper and use `GridState.mem_columnSwapNeighbors.mpr ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩` at the call site.

findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/KnotTheory/Grid/DifferentialSquareSupport.lean:88`, `:97`, and `:103` prove `x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors = ∅` for `n ≤ 1`, `0`, and `1`, which directly implies the new `x ∉ x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors` results.
findings.fix: Remove these wrappers; use `by rw [x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_le_one hn]; simp` or the existing simp lemmas `twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_zero/one`.
findings.issue: The small-grid negative self-membership lemmas at lines 120, 126, and 131 are special cases of the existing emptiness lemmas for all two-step targets.

findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/KnotTheory/Grid/DifferentialSupportCardinality.lean:122` proves `G.fullyBlockedDifferential = 0` for `n ≤ 1`, which is stronger than `G.fullyBlockedDifferential (G.fullyBlockedDifferential (Finsupp.single x 1)) x = 0`.
findings.fix: Remove these coefficient-level special cases; use `G.fullyBlockedDifferential_eq_zero_of_le_one hn` and then `simp` to obtain any coefficient of the square, including the diagonal.
findings.issue: The diagonal `∂²` zero lemmas at lines 145, 152, and 158 duplicate the broader existing theorem that the fully blocked differential itself is zero in grid size at most one.

summary: Several new public lemmas are thin specializations of existing TauCeti API rather than new reusable material.
